metadata.title: Marvell Stock Is on a Bad Run, but Microsoft’s New AI Chips Can Revive It<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Marvell Stock Is on a Bad Run, but Microsoft’s New AI Chips Can Revive It
Microsoft sure picked a bad time to unveil its latest artificial-intelligence chips —but the launch should still be seen as a positive for Marvell stock, an AI darling that has lost some of its luster in recent days.
